The '''Third Battle of Aefao''' was fought at<ref name="Warfare" /> the [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> [[Aefao]] between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Warfare" />

During the battle, Separatist [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Hoom Garaf]] was [[Death/Legends|executed]] by [[Hoom Garaf's T-series tactical droid|his]] [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] after the two disagreed. A [[Lightfight|firefight]] erupted in the Separatist rear guard because of Garaf's death, and as a result, the battle turned in the Republic's favor.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Third Battle of Aefao was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference book penned by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
